name: Hymnus
source: The Hierophant of Mithras, and father of Harp. In addition to being head of the Mithraic religion he is also the sovereign monarch ruling the lands where most of the story takes place. He is deeply concerned with Caprese's progress and tries to see to it that he is directed toward the path of the Light. His Arcana is obviously the Hierophant.
